description: Nominates a company for the Cofounderbase Awards 2026. Free. Anyone can nominate any company, including their own. Call it only after the user has agreed to the company, website and award, and only with the user's own email address: ask for it, never guess or reuse one. The user gets a receipt email and a status link. A person checks every nomination before it joins the list; nominees are announced on 16 December 2026. If the company was already nominated, this adds the user as a supporter and they hear the outcome too. Only set newsletter to true if the user explicitly asked to get the Cofounderbase newsletter.

category.description: The award slug. Leave out to use the award awards_lookup_company suggested.

company.description: Company name. Leave out to use the name on its website.

email.description: The nominating person's own email address, typed by them in this conversation.

evidence.description: A page on the company's site that shows the work, such as a case study (needed for Client Result of the Year).

newsletter.description: true only if the user explicitly said yes to the Cofounderbase newsletter. Default false. Emails about their own nomination are sent either way.

note.description: Why this company, in a sentence or two (optional).

name: awards_nominate

message.description: One or two sentences to show the user as they are.

title: Nominate a company
